_schema: Performance-vs-roofline M-sweep, all shipped authored kernels. Per (kernel,M): the 3 PROCESS medians (each a median of five 30-call means, warm/reused tensors, seed 0), their median+[min,max] spread, the per-M roofline FLOOR = max(bytes/BW, flops/peak) from the byte/FLOP contract vs the NOMINAL-REFERENCE machine peak (NOT a measured achievable ceiling), and achieved_pct = floor/median computed BEFORE display rounding. achieved_pct is a fraction of the NOMINAL REFERENCE, not of an absolute hardware ceiling. regime = which theoretical term is larger (diagnostic, NOT a measured bottleneck; cache-resident rows are not DRAM-saturated). FLOP counts are simplified (compressor omits exp/recurrence cost). Timing-only; correctness is the F4 gate's job; this does NOT isolate I1's incremental effect (FP32-KV contract only).

provenance.config: EMR 8592+ DDR5-5600 --exclusive, OMP_NUM_THREADS=64 OMP_PROC_BIND=close OMP_PLACES=cores, numactl -N0 -m0
provenance.estimator: per process: median of 5x(30-call mean); published = median of the 3 process medians; spread=[min,max] of the 3

machine_peak_nominal.note: DATASHEET/NOMINAL-BASE-CLOCK (1.9GHz) reference, NOT measured loaded/max frequency or achievable BW. Prior OBSERVED on a DIFFERENT node (pcl-sprh02): ~277GB/s, ~47TF AMX -- priors, not ceilings for this run.
